slides.title: Quarterly Business Review
slides.subtitle: Ascension Provider Services | FY27 PI-1
slides.notes: Welcome. This review covers FY27 PI-1, sprints 1 to 6, July to September 2026, for the ACM Enhancements (Provider and Network Services) Salesforce program.

slides.text: “Unless we are making progress in our nursing every year, every month, every week, take my word for it, we are going back.”
slides.attribution: Florence Nightingale, founder of modern nursing
slides.notes: Adapted from Florence Nightingale's addresses to her nurses (1870s). Tie-in: this quarter moved forward every sprint and every week. Six sprints, thirteen weekly regression cycles, and Texas CIN moved from build into business UAT.
